releaseTitle: ATalk v3.2.0 — Instant Chat Hydration, Smart Bottom Scroll & Notification Silence
releaseNotes:
• Instantaneous chat list & message loading: Hydrates conversations and messages from local encrypted disk cache in < 1ms on Frame 0 with zero wait time or blank screens
• Fixed chat open scroll position: Chats now immediately open anchored at the latest messages at the bottom with 0ms delay
• Suppressed notifications globally as requested
• WhatsApp-grade ultra-low bandwidth performance optimizations
